comment: recupererENV returns the EnveloppeREC02 shape, which adds aUneELOValide (and
optionally a base64 pdf) on top of the plain Enveloppe fields — this stub
shows an envelope further along the lifecycle than the create/modify stubs:
APPAIREE (paired to a physical crossing) with its declaration CONFORME, to
demonstrate the full field set a caller can expect once customs has cleared
it. numeroDossier is echoed back from the request (ENV_REC01 identifies the
envelope that way); jeton/dates are fixed illustrative samples.
To rehearse the 400 path, copy this file, change response.status to 400 and
the jsonBody to the ENV_REC03 shape ({ numeroDossier, statut,
libelleErreur }), then give it a higher priority and a narrower matcher.
